ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio characterized by dominant high-intensity white pixels (approx. 75%) against low-intensity black margins and spotting (approx. 25%) across the visible surface.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Discrete dark circular clusters and localized high-contrast points are visible against the white background, predominantly on the distal third of the left lobe and along the lower inner white-black transition boundary of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular jaggedness and deep, non-uniform indentations on the trailing edge of the right lobe suggestive of historic tissue loss or severe mechanical wear beyond standard serration.
